# Magic Starter Plugin

Ready-made Magic screens for sign-in, profile and security settings, teams, notifications, billing and support, each behind an opt-in toggle (all default `false`) and each replaceable by key through `MagicStarter.view`. The controllers are the client of `magic-starter-laravel`'s `api/v1` routes (`src/routes/api.php` there); change one side of that contract, keep the other in sync.

**Version:** 1.8.0 · **Dart:** >=3.13.0 · **Flutter:** >=3.47.0 · **Requires:** `magic` ^1.0.0, `magic_notifications` ^1.2.0, `magic_payments` ^1.0.0

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `flutter test --coverage` | Run all tests with coverage |
| `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos` | Static analysis |
| `dart format .` | Format all code |
| `flutter pub publish --dry-run` | Pre-publish check |
| `python3 tool/check-docs.py` | Docs structure, links, fragments and ToC anchors; README and `llms.txt` join the link checks |

The package has no `bin/`: in a host app the commands are `dart run magic:dowel starter:install|configure|doctor|publish|uninstall`.

## Architecture

```
lib/
├── magic_starter.dart           # Runtime barrel, the only public API
├── cli.dart                     # Flutter-free barrel: MagicStarterDowelProvider only
├── previews.dart                # Dev-only component previews, kept out of the runtime barrel
├── config/magic_starter.dart    # Config template
└── src/
    ├── magic_starter_manager.dart   # Singleton: user factory, team resolver, nav, sub-themes, view registry; registers default view keys in its constructor
    ├── facades/                 # MagicStarter: bootstrap(), use*() setters, switchTeam, view
    ├── configuration/           # MagicStarterConfig (toggles, routes, keys), MagicStarterTheme and sub-themes
    ├── providers/               # MagicStarterServiceProvider: auth listeners, push identity, Gate abilities
    ├── routes/                  # registerMagicStarter*Routes(), MagicStarterLayoutIds
    ├── middleware/              # EnsureAuthenticated, RedirectIfAuthenticated
    ├── http/                    # Controllers, concerns/ (CompletesSignIn, NavigatesRoutes), guest claim
    ├── contracts/               # MagicStarterSocialAuth bridge
    ├── support/                 # Step-up proof, plan upgrade, store review, support sync, app build
    ├── testing/                 # setUpMagicStarterForTests
    ├── ui/                      # layouts/, views/, components/ (MS*), widgets/, theme/ (tokens, breakpoints), view registry, page chrome
    └── cli/                     # MagicStarterDowelProvider, commands/, helpers/

install.yaml                     # Injects the provider; bootstrap_command: starter:install
assets/stubs/install/            # Stubs starter:install writes (config, models, middleware, routes, dashboard, en.stub)
example/                         # Runnable app: boots the provider offline, shows config and view registry, opens auth.login
doc/                             # User docs, published by the docs site: getting-started/, basics/, architecture/, guides/
skills/magic-starter/            # Agent skill (SKILL.md plus references/), installed with `npx skills add anilcancakir/magic_starter`
tool/check-docs.py               # Offline docs gate, run by docs-link-check.yml
```

## Post-Change Checklist

After any source code change, sync before committing. A change is not done while one of these is stale:

1. **`CHANGELOG.md`**: Add entry under `[Unreleased]` section
2. **`README.md`, `llms.txt` and the `doc/` pages**: Update if features, API, or usage changes
3. **`skills/magic-starter/`**: Update `SKILL.md` and its `references/` when the API, a rule or a gotcha changes; its `version:` moves with the release, and the publish check compares it with the tag
4. **`CLAUDE.md`**: Update the architecture tree when files move
5. **`example/`**: Keep `lib/main.dart` booting the real provider and calling the real API
6. **`magic-starter-laravel`**: A changed endpoint, payload or feature flag changes there too

## Development Flow (TDD)

Every feature, fix, or refactor goes through red-green-refactor: write a failing test, write the minimum code to pass it, then clean up with the tests green. No production code without a failing test first; `flutter test`, `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos` and `dart format .` stay clean after every change.

## Testing

- `test/fixtures/wire/*.json` are recorded backend answers; keep them in the backend's shape
- Tests mirror `lib/src/` in `test/`; `test/integration/cross_feature_smoke_test.dart` boots several features together
- Local runs resolve the sibling packages through an untracked `pubspec_overrides.yaml` with absolute paths; CI resolves the published ones

## Key Gotchas

| Mistake | Fix |
|---------|-----|
| Passing `password:` to a gated profile call | `doEnableTwoFactor`, `doDisableTwoFactor`, `getRecoveryCodes`, `doRegenerateRecoveryCodes`, `doRevokeSession`, `doRevokeOtherSessions`, `doDeleteAccount` and `doSetPassword` take `proof:`; the screens get it from `confirmIdentity` / `confirmAndRun` |
| Concluding a sign-in by hand | Every token (password, social, two-factor challenge, OTP, guest, handoff) goes through `CompletesSignIn.completeSignIn`, which also reads `two_factor` at the top level and under `data` |
| Reading a feature flag inline | Go through `MagicStarterConfig.has<Feature>Features()`, so a key lives in one place |
| Expecting a view key while its toggle is off | The manager constructor registers default keys from the config when the manager is first resolved, so a toggle set later (a `Config.set` after boot) registers nothing; `make()` throws `StateError` for a missing key |
| Adding a notification screen to `MagicStarter.view` | `notifications.list` and `notifications.preferences` belong to `magic_notifications`' `Notify.view`; `registerMagicStarterNotificationRoutes()` wraps them there |
| Documenting `profile.settings` as a view key | It is not registered by default; the settings surface is `settings.hub` plus `profile.profile`, `settings.*` and `settings.security.*`. `MagicStarterProfileController.profile()` and the publish map still name it |
| Expecting a `teams.billing` route | `lib/` registers only the view key; the host mounts it at `routes.billing` |
| Overriding a `starter.*` Gate ability before this provider boots | `boot()` defines them again; a host overrides after `MagicStarterServiceProvider` |
| Adding an import to a publishable view or layout | The file is copied into the host: its imports must resolve there through the package barrel (or a `package:magic_starter/src/...` path the publish command can rewrite); `magic_starter_publish_compiles_test` fails otherwise |
| A new direct dependency or a raised floor | `pubspec.yaml` comments say why each floor sits where it does; keep the reason next to the constraint |
| Relative paths in `pubspec_overrides.yaml` | Use absolute ones; the file is never committed |

## Release

1. Open a `release:` PR that bumps `pubspec.yaml`, `magicStarterVersion` in `lib/src/cli/starter_dowel_provider.dart`, `skills/magic-starter/SKILL.md` and the `Version:` line above, and promotes `[Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`.
   pub.dev rejects a `CHANGELOG.md` over 262144 bytes and `--dry-run` does not catch it; `Validate` checks the size, so when the file nears the limit move the oldest releases to `CHANGELOG-ARCHIVE.md` in their own PR first (`publish.yml` extracts the tag's notes from `CHANGELOG.md` only).
2. After it merges, tag the merge commit on `master` with the bare version (`git tag <version> && git push origin <version>`, no `v`). `publish.yml` runs from the tag; the pub.dev Admin tab holds repository `anilcancakir/magic_starter`, tag pattern `{{version}}` and push events only.
3. A failed `Validate` is fixed forward: delete the tag (`git push --delete origin <tag>` and `git tag -d <tag>`), fix it on a PR and tag the new merge commit. If only `GitHub Release` fails after pub.dev accepted the version, use "Re-run failed jobs" (never "Re-run all jobs") or `gh release create <tag> --title <tag> --latest --verify-tag --notes-file <file>`.

## CI

- `ci.yml` (`Lint & Test`): push/PR to `master` → `flutter pub get` → `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos` → `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` → `flutter test --coverage` → codecov upload
- `changelog.yml`: a PR that changes `lib/`, `install.yaml` or `assets/stubs/` must also change `CHANGELOG.md`; Dependabot, `release:` PRs and the `skip-changelog` label are exempt
- `docs-link-check.yml` (`Internal Links`, `External Links`): every PR runs `python3 tool/check-docs.py` and an offline lychee pass; Mondays an external-link pass
- `publish.yml`: tag on `master` → version stamps (tag, pubspec, skill) → analyze, format, test, dry-run, pana 160/160, changelog section → OIDC publish → GitHub Release → `dispatch-to-registry.yml` mirrors `skills/magic-starter/` into `anilcancakir/ai`
